meaning:
ἥσσων (Rec. ἥττ-, the Attic literary form), ἧσσων,
inferior, less; neut., τὸ ἧ., adverbially, less: 2Co.12:15; εἰς τὸ ἧ., for the worse (opposite to κρεῖττον): 1Co.11:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But in giving you this command, I don’t praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
